title: Aye meri jaan hussain
body:
Haye mazloom hussain..(3)
Haye mazloom hussain..(3)
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain
Khaak se uth meri aghosh ke marjan hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Khaak aluda badan khoon mein tarr hai jabi'n
naiza seene mein gadha, teer paiwast kahi'n
maarte hai tujhe patthar bhi musalman hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mere hatho'n se sawarte the gesu jo kabhi
god mein leke jinhe chuma karte the nabi
teri un khoo'n bhari zulfo'n pe mai qurban hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Roshni ab na teri maa ki ankho'n mein rahi
khaak par baithe hue aaj rote hai Ali
dekh nana hai khade chaak garebaan hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Maa yu maqtal ki zamee'n saaf balo'n se kare
kaash bache ko mere koi kaa'nta na chubhe
ran mein ghode se gire jab sar e maidan hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Mar gaya ghazi hue neher par baazu qalam
cheeno asbab sabhi loot lo ehle haram
kar diya shimr ne maqtal mein ye ailaan hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Khoon kaano se rase neel gaalo'n pe pade
khol to aankhein zara dekh qatil se tere
jhidkiya'n khake Sakina hai pareshan hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Pyaas se khushk ragein kund zalim ki churi
tham kar reesh teri baitha seene pe shaqi
dekhe Zainab na tujhe qatl ke dauran hussain
aye meri jaan hussain..
Aye meri jaan hussain, maa ko pehchan hussain..(2)
